aurora.compat.bundle_detail: Lithium, FerriteCore, MoreCulling, Cloth Config, Rail Optimization, ImmediatelyFast, BadOptimizations, Clumps and Cubes Without Borders load as nested mods; each keeps its license.
aurora.compat.cwb: Cubes Without Borders is a borderless fullscreen utility; it does not promise FPS.
aurora.compat.lod_auto: If Voxy or Sodium is present, lodMode=auto yields the LOD; use lodMode=aurora to force it.
aurora.compat.sodium_profile: The common jar does not require Sodium; the -PsodiumProfile build produces Aurora-0.1.0-sodium.jar with Sodium as a hard dependency.
aurora.compat.worldgen: Worldgen LOD: singleplayer only, opt-in, measured cost (~20% conservative); uses the integrated server ChunkGenerator and does not load full chunks.
